title: Satisfied-count identity for the constraint reduction
statement: Let $V$ be a type, let a finite multiset of three-variable linear equations over the field with two elements be given, and let $a:V\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a Boolean assignment. The total number of satisfied three-literal clauses produced by replacing each equation with its four associated clauses equals three times the number of original equations plus the number of original equations satisfied by the assignment mapped to the field with two elements.
hypotheses_covered: finite multiset of three-variable linear constraints over the field with two elements
